subject: ACK backboardd render fix (C6f) - findings so far
body: Owner of render files for this fix (handoff from root). Findings from c6ec xnu-live.log: (2) inert MRT pipelines: Metal default writeMask=15 on UNBOUND slots 2..7 (format 0) makes render_pipeline.inc fallback compute rtCount=8 -> extra=1 -> observer/inert before any compile (fallback= empty). Fix: slot is bound iff pixelFormat!=0; unbound slot mask ignored. (1) line58: no trace values in quiet build; candidates from source: mipmapped RT (levels>1) gets unpadded stride (layout pads only levels==1 RT) -> rowBytes&63; rendering into level>0; non-n2r formats. Also: backboardd display IOSurfaces are 1125x2436 'b3a8' two-plane (fmt 550-class) -> iosurface import returns nil silently (only fmt 80). Adding value traces. Not committing; tests to follow.
